title: What The Oud Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal oud world instruments Arabic philosophy comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The oud is the oldest instrument in the room
By about three thousand years
It doesn't mention this
But it plays with the authority of something
That has been doing this longer than most civilisations

[Verse 2]
Eleven strings and no frets
The oud refuses frets
Frets are for instruments that have decided
Where the notes are
The oud knows the notes are not fixed
The oud plays between them

[Chorus]
What the oud knows
Has no fixed position
What the oud knows
Is precision without prison
The sliding note, the maqam and the mode
What the oud knows — the oud has always known

[Bridge]
Chas found an oud player once at a festival
Said — why no frets?
The player said — because the feeling is between the notes
Chas nodded
Said — that's the slower ball
That's exactly the slower ball

[Verse 3]
Arabic in the oud
Shona in the mbira
Japanese in the koto
Italian in the accordion
Every language keeps itself alive
In the instrument that understands it best

[Outro]
What the oud knows
What the oud knows
Three thousand years
What the oud knows
That's my boy
